author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect, rust-quality applied).** Proto-blue check: proto_blue_api::generated::com::atproto::identity::{signPlcOperation, submitPlcOperation, requestPlcOperationSignature} provide the full PLC operation surface. New binary polaris-publish-did-service in workspace. CLI: --account <handle/did> --service-url --signing-key <did:key:> --did-method <plc|web>. For did:plc: request signature via requestPlcOperationSignature → fetch from operator's email → signPlcOperation → submitPlcOperation. For did:web: print the well-known/.well-known/did.json JSON for the operator to host. Validates the resulting DID document contains a verification entry for #atproto_labeler pointing at the service_url.
